title: Field Editors and Display Modes: One Field, Many Faces | Orchard Core
description:
A content field has a default way to be edited and a default way to appear on the site, and the default does not always fit the data. A Numeric Field for seats can be a slider, and a Text Field for a headline can be a heading.

Orchard Core separates both choices from the stored value. An editor changes how a value is entered on the edit screen, and a display mode changes how it is shown to visitors. You set both in the settings of each field on its content type.

In this video:
• One field, many faces: fields, editors and display modes
• Choose an editor: a Numeric Field as a slider
• An editor with its own settings: a Text Field as a list of choices
• Choose a display mode: a Text Field as a heading
• What each field offers: the editors and display modes of the Content Fields module
